root_cause: A keyword score and short alias may be insufficient to prove that an entirely new search-intent article is needed when an existing commercial canonical owner is available.
fix: Apply deterministic source-freshness, service-relevance, canonical owner, pending-topic deduplication and independent-evidence gates inside the existing resolver. Admit only one private new candidate per daily resolver cycle.
prevention_rule: Do not create a new blog recommendation from search volume, CPC or modeled forecasts alone. A recommendation is not permission to export a draft or publish.
terminal_rule: Protected exact-head CI and sole-writer source merge, authorized Supabase production deployment and independent source/readback; downstream public blog still needs separate approval, public-only egress and Netlify URL proof. No conversion impact is claimed.
